description: White stone wall tile from Pak Clay, a natural-stone cladding tile in a light, clean tone. The textured stone face suits feature walls, front elevations and entrances, and pairs well with brick, timber or darker plaster. Natural stone varies in tone and texture from piece to piece, so view a sample before ordering and keep all tiles from one batch. Ask your fixer about the right adhesive and fixing method for your wall. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
